lines.text: A tutorial is a placement-of-words. The library holds the words
lines.note: nothing in this room is its own: the placard holds the placement and a library holds the words, and the formula reads as recognition only for a body that already walked the sequences it claims to unify

lines.text: Grabbable sphere representing F (Free Energy) - the order-seeking
Grabbable sphere representing E(S) (Entropy) - the freedom and possibility space
Grabbable sphere representing λ (lambda) - the entropy drive parameter. Green glow
the octahedron is the cube's dual — swap faces and vertices and you get the other
lines.note: the puzzle needs the cube it is the dual of, and the cube is never drawn: the `dual` axis ships off and this map never sets it, so order's founding relation is asserted rather than shown

lines.text: you cannot enclose volume with fewer than 4 faces — the tetrahedron is the minimum
a seed turns chance into a decision you can repeat
Entropy counts the ways: S = k log W - one macrostate, astronomically many microstates
lines.note: S = k log W needs a box before a number: W is cells^N with the cells chosen by hand, and unsealing the jar makes the ledger print nothing — the seal is what made the count mean anything

lines.text: More ways to be is more entropy - possibility itself is what S measures
Entropy is the size of the space of what could be - few accessible states vs many
entropy is not disorder but possibility — maximum spread means maximum freedom from …
randomness is not the absence of information but the presence of all possible configurations …
Particles at the edge of chaos (λ≈0.4). Dancing, self-organizing, alive
at lambda=1, information has no structure — dissolution is not destruction but the liberation of …
A corridor where your position = r parameter in the logistic map
lines.note: your position is the parameter, so r 2.5 to 4.0 is twelve metres and lambda's resolution is your stride — and the cascade hangs at head height, so the body reading the diagram walks through and displaces it

lines.text: form is not permanent — every structure carries its own dissolution encoded in the noise of its …
at lambda=0, prediction error is zero — the crystal has no surprises
at the edge of chaos, simple local rules generate unbounded computational complexity
a seed turns chance into a decision you can repeat
negative phi crystallizes form into monument — the rigid sculpture is beautiful and dead
lines.note: phi weights a rate and the monument has no clock: rigid_sculpture ships with no _process at all, so negative phi is argued by deleting time — and resistance becomes indistinguishable from being dead

lines.text: positive phi means embracing transformation — the fluid form is not broken, it is becoming
negative phi preserves pattern at the cost of life
positive phi means the pattern itself is in motion
A zone where complexity emerges. Particles self-organize at the edge of chaos
Reaction-diffusion Turing pattern. Spots, stripes, labyrinths
life does not exist at order or chaos but at the narrow boundary between them
when you control lambda, you understand the parameter space
lines.note: the argument is made by withholding — lambda locked at 0.4 so criticality arrives as a condition, not a choice — and the unlocked companion stands in the same room, which makes the withholding a stage direction

pearls.edge: the reunion is furnished from outside itself: every creature here was befriended in another chamber, and a mode fired alone lights its term on the screen and moves nothing — coherence is all the calibrator can read

lines.text: Alias for reactive_particle_field. Particles that respond to λ and φ parameters
lines.note: you get every slider but the one that decides: lambda buys how much order, never what order looks like — a single line of geometry lays the cubic lattice the field falls into, and no control reaches it

lines.text: the reactor is the QFEP formula made tangible
queer morphology is not a fixed form but a process of becoming
lines.note: the form that refuses to be one thing needs the vitrine to read as a specimen at all: jar sealed, lid seated, pedestal under it, shipped at quarter scale — becoming is legible here only as something collected
